shortlist_rule: Each held-back window takes the best setup of every model, the best per kind of market (rising, falling, range, read from that window's search period only) and the best per side (long and short); every shortlisted setup is then replayed on every window. Before 3 Nov one cut of 90 days took the best of each model, then the next best pairs up to 5.
pass_rule: A setup passes only if it made money on at least three quarters of the windows, its pooled result over all windows cleared the bar (counting every combination ever tried) and it closed at least 20 trades across them, net of the fee and slippage every replay pays.
